submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the exact edit target; image2 is approved PRIMARY painting style. Make ONE full-body transparent RGBA sprite, native at least1024. Preserve camera, character face/head, hair, costume, scale and overall root position. Correct only the specified joints/object details by independently drawing them. Never mirror or deform the picture. No text, particles, floor shadow or extra appendages. Correct LOWER BODY to RIGHT-foot final TOE-OFF, next phase after image3. The RIGHT leg from SCREEN LEFT shorts hem extends BACK, its ankle extended and boot almost vertical with heel raised; ONLY its toe/forefoot presses the invisible ground at y940. LEFT knee from SCREEN RIGHT bow-side shorts opening is now lifted forward, left boot above ground in front. Body pushes forward off the RIGHT toes, not an airborne outstretched right leg. Clear separation: long supporting right leg behind, compact left knee ahead, then flight follows. Keep upper body scale/face and arms in same general phase, left hand grips long bow at rear hip, right empty fist forward at chest. Preserve full-length bamboo bow with both tips safely inside canvas.
 Image3 is the immediately previous corrected phase. Advance its leg/arm joints into the requested next support/toe-off phase while retaining which leg supports. Do not copy or mirror Image3.
